title: Do you know signs of a stroke? BE FAST are the words to remember
content: Sen. Chris Murphy is expected to fully recover from his stroke. The acronym BE FAST can help you remember the symptoms of stroke and what to do when it happens: Call 911 quickly.

title: Gulf region on edge as Qatar leads talks with Iran to stave off new U.S. attacks
content: Qatar has been leading intense mediation efforts over the past 72 hours to prevent a new round of possible U.S. attacks on Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections. The uncertainty has the entire Gulf region on edge.

title: Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan Senate race, spurning Abdul El-Sayed
content: Rep. Haley Stevens was scheduled to attend a unity event today with Abdul El-Sayed, who beat her in the Democratic primary. Instead, she endorsed his Republican opponent, Mike Rogers.

title: Connecticut Senator Chris Murphy is hospitalized with a stroke
content: Murphy's office says he was taken to the hospital this weekend after experiencing numbness in his arm. His chief of staff said he is responding well to treatment and expected to make a full recovery.

title: How to think about the midterms — and the political moment the country is in
content: Polls show Democrats with an advantage in the midterm election but there are potential limitations and results may take a while to roll in.

title: Judge tosses Trump's attempt to block Alaska Senate results if GOP incumbent loses
content: A federal judge has dismissed a highly unusual lawsuit by the Trump administration that tried to block the certification of results from Alaska's U.S. Senate race if the Republican incumbent lost.

title: The midterms will test the nation's political direction and confidence
content: At least some portion of the nation is likely to have its political confidence — and perhaps even its sense of security — tested in the days and weeks ahead. That test could also continue for some time to come.

title: New York City Marathon: Sweden's Almgren and Kenya's Chepkirui win as 60,000 take part
content: Andreas Almgren of Sweden won the men's race of the New York City Marathon in his debut in the event while Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya won the women's race on Sunday for the second time.

title: Living with high prices in Virginia's 1st Congressional District
content: High prices are straining budgets for both a small business owner and a single mom in a rural part of Va.'s 1st Congressional district. They explain how they're handling the economic stress of these times.

title: It's ACA open enrollment time. Here are the changes for health insurance shoppers
content: The ACA health insurance marketplaces — find yours at HealthCare.gov — open Nov. 1 for 2027 coverage. Getting an early start may be especially important this year.
